title: D. Domain Expansion Abraham échate un hint

legend: Rem, Alex, José, and Abraham are spending the weekend exploring La Plata in the middle of the Training Camp Argentina. During their trip, they decide to visit an attraction called La República de los Pibitos.

The attraction consists of $$$n$$$ locations, numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$. From each location, there is exactly one path leading to another location. Therefore, La República de los Pibitos can be represented as a functional graph: every vertex has exactly one outgoing edge.

The graph is connected if the directions of the edges are ignored. Consequently, it contains exactly one directed cycle. Finding this cycle is one of the main attractions of La República de los Pibitos.

Abraham has already seen the map and knows which locations belong to the cycle. However, Rem, Alex, and José have not. Instead of showing them the map, Abraham challenges them to determine all the vertices of the cycle using at most $$$3n$$$ hints.

For each hint, they may choose two integers $$$u$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le u \le n$$$, $$$1 \le k \le n$$$). Starting at vertex $$$u$$$, consider the sequence of vertices visited while following the unique outgoing edge exactly $$$k$$$ times. Thus, the sequence contains the starting vertex and the $$$k$$$ vertices reached after each step.
Abraham will answer whether some vertex appears more than once in this sequence, or whether all visited vertices are distinct.
Using at most $$$3n$$$ such hints, Rem, Alex, and José must determine exactly which vertices belong to the unique directed cycle of La República de los Pibitos.
input: The input contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 10^4$$$) — the number of vertices in the functional graph.
After reading $$$n$$$, the interaction starts.
You can ask Abraham at most $$$3n$$$ hints.

To ask a hint, output a line in the following format: "? $$$u$$$ $$$k$$$", where $$$u$$$ is the starting vertex and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le k \le n$$$) is the number of edges that will be traversed by repeatedly following the unique outgoing edge.
After each hint, the evaluator will provide a single line containing:
"Yes", if some vertex is visited more than once among the starting vertex and the $$$k$$$ vertices reached after each step;
"No", if all these $$$k+1$$$ visited vertices are distinct.

Once you have determined all the vertices that belong to the unique directed cycle, output a line in the following format: "! $$$m$$$ $$$v_1$$$ $$$v_2$$$ $$$\dots$$$ $$$v_m$$$", where $$$m$$$ is the number of vertices in the cycle and $$$v_1,v_2,\dots,v_m$$$ are exactly the vertices that belong to it, in any order.

The graph is guaranteed to be a connected functional graph, meaning every vertex has exactly one outgoing edge and the underlying undirected graph is connected. Therefore, the graph contains exactly one directed cycle.
After printing each line, do not forget to output the end of the line and flush the output buffer. Otherwise, you will receive the "Idleness limit exceeded" verdict. To flush, use:
"fflush(stdout)" or "cout.flush()" in C++;
"System.out.flush()" in Java;
"flush(output)" in Pascal;
"stdout.flush()" in Python.

The interactor is adaptive. This means that the functional graph is not necessarily fixed before the interaction starts. Instead, the interactor may determine the hidden graph based on the queries made by your program, as long as all answers given during the interaction are consistent with at least one connected functional graph.
note: The functional graph for this example is shown below:
For the first hint, "? 4 3", starting from vertex $$$4$$$ and walking $$$3$$$ steps visits the vertices $$$4, 1, 2, 3$$$. Since all of them are different, the answer is "No".
For the second hint, "? 4 4", the visited vertices are $$$4, 1, 2, 3, 1$$$. Vertex $$$1$$$ is visited twice, so the answer is "Yes".
For the third hint, "? 1 2", the visited vertices are $$$1, 2, 3$$$. Since all of them are different, the answer is "No".
For the fourth hint, "? 1 3", the visited vertices are $$$1, 2, 3, 1$$$. Vertex $$$1$$$ is visited twice, so the answer is "Yes".
Finally, the vertices belonging to the unique directed cycle are $$$1$$$, $$$2$$$, and $$$3$$$. Therefore, a valid final answer is "! 3 1 3 2". The vertices of the cycle may be reported in any order.

titleZh: D. 领域扩张 亚伯拉罕给出提示

legend: 雷姆、亚历克斯、何塞和亚伯拉罕正在阿根廷训练营的拉普拉塔度过周末。旅途中，他们决定去参观一个名为 La República de los Pibitos 的景点。
吸引力由 $$$n$$$ 个位置组成，编号从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$。从每个位置出发，只有一条路径通往另一个位置。因此，La República de los Pibitos 可以用一个函数图来表示：每个顶点只有一条出口边。
如果忽略边的方向，则图形是连通的。因此，它恰好包含一个有向圈。发现这个周期是La República de Los Pibitos的主要吸引力之一。
亚伯拉罕已经看过地图，知道哪些地点属于循环。但是雷姆、亚历克斯和何塞却不知道。亚伯拉罕没有给他们看地图，而是让他们用最多 $$$3n$$$ 个提示来确定循环的所有顶点。
对于每个提示，他们可以选择两个整数 $$$u$$$ 和 $$$k$$$($$$1 \le u \le n$$$,$$$1 \le k \le n$$$)。从顶点 $$$u$$$ 开始，考虑沿着唯一的出口边精确地 $$$k$$$ 次访问的顶点序列。因此，序列包含起始顶点和每步之后到达的 $$$k$$$ 顶点。
Abraham将回答是否某个顶点在这个序列中出现了不止一次，或者是否所有访问的顶点都是不同的。
最多使用$$$3n$$$这样的提示，Rem、Alex和José必须准确地确定哪些顶点属于La República de Los Pibitos的唯一有向圈。
input: 输入包含一个整数 $$$n$$$($$$1 \le n \le 10^4$$$)——函数图中顶点的数量。
阅读$$$n$$$后，交互开始。
您最多可以向亚伯拉罕询问$$$3n$$$个提示。
要询问提示，请按以下格式输出一行："? $$$u$$$ $$$k$$$"，其中 $$$u$$$ 是起始顶点，$$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le k \le n$$$）是通过重复跟随唯一的出站边而遍历的边的数量。
在每个暗示之后，评估员将提供一行包含以下内容的信息：
“是”，如果在起始顶点和每一步到达的$$$k$$$顶点中，某个顶点被访问了不止一次；
“否”，如果所有这些$$$k+1$$$访问的顶点是不同的。
确定属于唯一有向循环的所有顶点后，请按以下格式输出一行："! $$$m$$$ $$$v_1$$$ $$$v_2$$$ $$$\dots$$$ $$$v_m$$$"，其中 $$$m$$$ 是循环中的顶点数，$$$v_1,v_2,\dots,v_m$$$ 是属于循环的顶点，顺序不限。
保证该图是一个连通的泛函图，这意味着每个顶点恰好有一条出边，并且底层的无向图是连通的。因此，该图恰好包含一个有向循环。
在打印每行之后，不要忘记输出行尾并刷新输出缓冲区。否则，您将收到“超过闲置限制”的判决。要冲洗，请使用：
C++中的“ fflush（stdout）”或“ cout.flush（）”
Java 中的 "System.out.flush()"；
帕斯卡语中的 “flush(output)”;
Python 中的 “stdout.flush()”。
交互器是自适应的。这意味着在交互开始之前，功能图并不一定是固定不变的。相反，只要在交互过程中给出的所有答案都与至少一个相连的功能图一致，交互器就可以根据程序的查询确定隐藏图。
note: 本示例的函数图如下所示：
对于第一个提示，“？”4 3”，从顶点$$$4$$$出发，走$$$3$$$步，访问顶点$$$4, 1, 2, 3$$$。因为它们都是不同的，所以答案是否定的。
对于第二个提示 “? 4 4”，访问的顶点是 $$$4, 1, 2, 3, 1$$$。顶点 $$$1$$$ 访问了两次，因此答案是 “是”。
对于第三个提示 “?12”，访问的顶点是 $$$1, 2, 3$$$。由于它们都是不同的，因此答案是 “否”。
对于第四个暗示，“？”，访问的顶点为$$$1, 2, 3, 1$$$。顶点$$$1$$$被访问了两次，所以答案是“是”。
最后，属于唯一有向循环的顶点是 $$$1$$$、$$$2$$$ 和 $$$3$$$。因此，有效的最终答案是"！3 1 3 2".循环的顶点可以以任何顺序报告。
